title: run_e2e.py pre-flight drift check + --ym propagation to sink/matrix
objective: Add --ym YYYY-MM to etl4/run_e2e.py argparse. Required when --source is one of s3|zenodo|rest; optional for synthetic (auto-defaults to SYN-002A inside run_matrix per T-20). Add check_watermark_vs_filesystem() pre-flight that aborts on three drift scenarios: (1) fs has ym dirs but no watermark row, (2) watermark row but filesystem empty, (3) non-contiguous range or extras past last_ym. stage_sink passes --ym to postgres_sink (PR4 requires it). stage_matrix threads --source, --ym, --methods, --workers through to run_matrix.
unblocks: T-27 (rewind E2E - requires drift check to NOT false-alarm post-rewind)

contract_deviations: Minor: drift check runs after stage_infra + stage_schema in the run set rather than strictly 'at top of main()' per the dispatch verbatim. Rationale per advisor: pipeline_watermarks lives in Postgres (brought up by stage_infra) and the table is created by stage_schema; running the check before either on a fresh machine would raise OperationalError / UndefinedTable with a less actionable message. The check is still before any stage that cares about the drift (vault/marts/sink/matrix) and before any FS writes. --skip-drift-check escape hatch added for emergency bypass.

The spec example '--methods time_gap' required a --methods CLI arg in run_e2e; added. --workers also added so the operator can force sequential mode (matches T-20 evidence pattern). Both forwarded to run_matrix.

--bronze default changed from a hardcoded 'data/bronze/raw_states' to None resolved per --source (synthetic -> data/bronze/synthetic, else raw_states). Keeps the real-source call signature identical to today; prevents real bronze from feeding the synthetic noise-truth path when --source synthetic is used with the previous default.
risks: stage_ingest now refuses --source in {s3, rest, synthetic} because ingest_runner.py choices are only {zenodo, live, replay}. Operator must pass --only / --skip ingest to run matrix-only against these sources. Argparse error message is actionable.

Drift check uses a broad `except Exception` that wraps OperationalError and UndefinedTable into an informative SystemExit referencing the --skip-drift-check escape hatch. If the operator genuinely wants to run --only infra/schema on a brand-new machine (where pipeline_watermarks does not yet exist), they must pass --skip-drift-check or the check will surface UndefinedTable. Documented in --help.

The drift check reads VAULT_PARTITIONED_TABLES as a module-level tuple (hub_flight, link_flight_aircraft, link_flight_route, sat_flight_summary) per the dispatch. sat_state_observation is NOT in the list even though it is partitioned in vault_io.PARTITIONED_TABLES; this is intentional per the dispatch spec but worth confirming in T-24 review.
notes: Implementation details: (a) check_watermark_vs_filesystem accepts root=... so the smoke can exercise all drift paths against a tmpdir without touching data/silver/vault. (b) Filtering fs_yms by _YM_CALENDAR_RE makes the check safe for tables that may one day accept SYN-* partitions (currently none of the 4; future-proof). (c) _months_between is local to run_e2e, NOT imported from rewind, because T-21 is a parallel sibling and may not have landed. (d) matrix_source falls back to 'zenodo' when --source=live because run_matrix does not know 'live'; this preserves prior behavior where `python etl4/run_e2e.py --source live` would still run the matrix against zenodo bronze, which is the production convention today.
